assumptions.rationale: The benchmark reached about 7.17% in late September 2026, a near two-year high, up from about 6.7% in July. Cap-rate spreads should be tested against 7.0-7.3%. On 3 November 2026 the yield eased to 7.30%, still near the highest since March 2023, as elevated crude and the RBI's calibrated-tightening stance kept pressure on; economists expect the repo rate to reach at least 6%. Base moved to 7.30% and the upper case to 7.5%. On 4 November 2026 the yield was 7.25%, down about 8 bps on the session as Brent eased towards $104; base set to 7.25%. On 5 November 2026 the yield was 7.12%, down about 12 bps on the session as crude eased; base set to 7.12%. On 6 November 2026 the yield was 7.17%, up about 4 bps on the session after touching a one-month low, with a ₹36,000 crore auction ahead; base set to 7.17%. On 9 November 2026 the yield was 7.18%, up about 1 bp on the session; base set to 7.18%. On 11 November 2026 the yield rose to about 7.21%, extending its rebound on higher US Treasury yields and concerns about extra bond supply (Trading Economics); base set to 7.21%. On 12 November 2026 the yield closed at about 7.25%, up about 4 bps on the session (Trading Economics); base set to 7.25%. On 13 November 2026 the yield rose to about 7.31%, up about 6 bps on the session, as accelerating inflation, heavy bond supply and expectations of another rate hike in early December weighed on prices (Trading Economics); base set to 7.31%. On 16 November 2026 the yield was about 7.34%, up about 2 bps on the session, as inflation above the RBI's tolerance band and heavy bond supply kept pressure on (Trading Economics); base set to 7.34%. On 17 November 2026 the yield eased to about 7.28%, down about 6 bps, as Brent slid towards $92 a barrel, though October CPI of 6.09% kept a December hike in view (Trading Economics); base set to 7.28%. On 18 November 2026 the yield was about 7.26%, slightly lower on the session and off its highest in nearly two weeks, as lower crude eased imported-inflation worries, though October CPI above 6% kept a December hike priced in (Trading Economics); base set to 7.26%. On 19 November 2026 the yield rose about 2 bps to about 7.28%, though it was down about 12 bps over the month, as markets kept pricing in another RBI rate increase in early December (Trading Economics); base set to 7.28%. On 20 November 2026 the yield fell about 10 bps to about 7.19%, as foreign investors returned to Indian government bonds and lower crude eased pressure, though inflation above the RBI's tolerance band kept a December hike in view (Trading Economics); base set to 7.19%. On 23 November 2026 the yield rose about 3 bps to about 7.22%, rebounding from its lowest in over a week as investors booked profits after the rally, with a December rate hike still expected after October inflation above 6% (Trading Economics); base set to 7.22%.

news.headline: Telangana pegs Bharat Future City core infrastructure at ₹18,000 crore
news.summary: The state estimates roughly ₹5,000 crore for roads, ₹6,000 crore for water and waste and ₹2,350 crore for power across a 30,000-acre core area; the master plan is due at the Invest Global Summit on 7-9 December.

news.headline: Knight Frank: retrofitting Kolkata offices could add ₹4,800 crore in value
news.summary: About a quarter of Kolkata's 34 msf office stock is judged eligible for retrofitting, which the report says could lift its value 48% to about ₹15,000 crore, most of it in the CBD.

news.headline: South Delhi luxury floor prices up as much as 40% in the September quarter
news.summary: Golden Growth Fund says a typical 2,500 sq ft floor in colonies such as Vasant Vihar, Golf Links and Jor Bagh rose to about ₹23.75 crore from ₹17 crore a year earlier; Category B colonies gained less.

news.headline: Haryana pollution board halts work at a Godrej Properties project in Sector 3, Gurugram
news.summary: The board cited alleged Air Act violations; Godrej told exchanges it is working to restart and expects no major financial impact.

news.headline: Runwal Realty plans ₹2,500 crore hotel arm with six properties
news.summary: About 1,000 keys across four business hotels and two resorts in Mumbai, Thane, Pune and Alibaug are planned over four to five years, funded 60:40 debt to equity.

news.headline: Gateway Distriparks wins eight-year mandate to run JNPA common rail yard
news.summary: The DFC-compliant terminal at Nhava Sheva handles mixed container trains, extending the company beyond its ICD and CFS operations.

news.headline: Goyal & Co puts ₹820 crore into Titanium Tech Park, Whitefield; Airbus and Caterpillar lease 1.18 msf
news.summary: The 25-acre campus is planned at about 5 msf over three phases, with 1.5 msf operational; Airbus took about 880,000 sq ft and Caterpillar 300,000 sq ft at a combined annual rent of about ₹100 crore.

news.headline: Collins Aerospace breaks ground on MRO facility at Devanahalli Aerospace Park
news.summary: The state has allotted 26 acres for the propeller-systems maintenance facility, which is expected to create about 2,100 direct jobs.

news.headline: K Raheja Corp signs JDA for 165-acre mixed-use township at Panvel
news.summary: The registered joint development agreement, reviewed by CRE Matrix, values the land at about ₹956 crore on a revenue-share basis; the mix and timeline were not disclosed.

news.headline: SRA issues revised LoI for JP Infra slum scheme in Malad East with 1,419 rehab homes
news.summary: The scheme on a 3.4-hectare plot, clubbed with an Andheri project, has sanctioned FSI of 4.77 and about 98,600 sq m of sale built-up area.

news.headline: Maharashtra Maritime Board appoints consultants for Mumbai Water Metro Phase 1
news.summary: Phase 1 covers 17 water routes linking 26 terminals across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, Palghar and Raigad; a Tissa-RINA joint venture will manage design and supervision.

news.headline: DMRC proposes eight Phase V(B) corridors, including Yashobhoomi to Gurugram
news.summary: Seven corridors totalling about 97 km have Delhi government approval and await the Centre; the Yashobhoomi-Rajiv Chowk Gurugram link is still under consideration.

news.headline: Signature Global adds about 10 acres in Sohna to its land bank
news.summary: The two parcels, taken under collaboration agreements, carry about 0.86 msf of developable area; investment value was not disclosed.

news.headline: MCD clears up to 75% rebate on PM-UDAY regularisation charges
news.summary: The Standing Committee approved the cut for Delhi's 1,511 unauthorised colonies across four charge heads; the rebate does not by itself confer ownership.

news.headline: Greater Chennai Corporation plans ₹12 crore makeover of 5.8 km airport approach road
news.summary: The Gateway of Chennai project between the airport and Kathipara flyover covers landscaping, lighting and pedestrian works, with a six-month target.

news.headline: North-west Hyderabad residents seek Metro extension from Kukatpally to Gandimaisamma
news.summary: The representation to the Chief Minister asks for a DPR for a corridor via Chintal, Jeedimetla and Suraram in the next Metro phase.

news.headline: Six listed REITs distribute over ₹3,234 crore for Q2 FY27
news.summary: Indian REITs Association data put gross AUM above ₹3.3 lakh crore across about 215 msf, with more than 5.25 lakh unitholders.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs sees repo rate at 6.25% by mid-2027
news.summary: It expects a 25 bps hike at the 2-4 December MPC and a further 50 bps in the first half of 2027, a faster path than its October view.

news.headline: Redbrick Offices raises ₹630 crore to expand managed office portfolio
news.summary: The operator plans to grow from 6.5 msf to over 10 msf in 18-24 months across its eight-city footprint.

news.headline: Bank of America leases about 10.1 lakh sq ft at Mindspace Cyberabad for its GCC
news.summary: BA Continuum India took the ground floor and floors 7-17 of Building 1 at ₹82 per sq ft a month for 12 years, with 15% escalation every three years, per registration documents.

news.headline: West Bengal drafts rules to scrap ground coverage caps
news.summary: A draft amendment to the municipal building rules would replace ground coverage limits with mandatory open-space norms and allow uncapped additional FAR outside hill areas; it is not yet in force.

news.headline: Karnataka targets 15 lakh free sites and approves one lakh houses
news.summary: The cabinet set a 2026-27 target of free residential sites for landless families, starting with five lakh, and cleared one lakh houses costing about ₹2,241 crore.

news.headline: Maharashtra registration offices to report cash property payments of ₹2 lakh or more
news.summary: Sub-registrars must send monthly reports of such cash components to the Income Tax Department, and the I-Sarita system will record cash and cheque payments separately.

news.headline: YEIDA allots 147 developed plots to farmers by lottery
news.summary: The draw adds to 295 plots allotted earlier in the week; about half of the roughly 4,000 plots owed to farmers have now been allotted.

news.headline: NHB proposes a ₹15 lakh affordable housing loan category for smaller cities
news.summary: The proposal for Tier-II and Tier-III cities is under consultation and does not yet change eligibility; NHB also plans 20 more RMBS deals over the next year.

news.headline: NDMC to consult stakeholders on unit-area property tax bye-laws
news.summary: Draft bye-laws would assess tax on covered area, age, use and location; consultation with RWAs and market associations is set for 23 November.

news.headline: County Group and Elate Realtors sign ₹830 crore JDA for 24.7 acres in Noida Sector 150
news.summary: County Group plans a luxury housing launch in December 2026 and will also build two public sports complexes in the Sports City project.

news.headline: Shriram Properties Q2 profit rises about 2.5 times to ₹21.6 crore
news.summary: Total income for the September quarter grew to about ₹272 crore from ₹229 crore a year earlier.

news.headline: Domicil opens a luxury furniture showroom at Spacio Tower, Kolkata
news.summary: The German brand, part of HTL International, is expanding its eastern India footprint; store size was not disclosed.

news.headline: Keystone Realtors plans ₹5,000 crore of MMR launches by March
news.summary: H1 FY27 bookings rose 11% to ₹2,041 crore; the Rustomjee developer targets ₹5,000 crore of bookings for the year, with redevelopment a core focus.

news.headline: Devgn CineX to open 34,000 sq ft multiplex at KB West Walk Mall, Greater Noida West
news.summary: The five-screen, roughly 737-seat cinema will anchor the upcoming mall by Shree KB Group; terms were not disclosed.

news.headline: AGM Vijaylaxmi launches 32-storey Sixty3 W.E. Residences in Goregaon East
news.summary: The tower offers only 2 BHK homes; no unit count or project price was disclosed.

news.headline: Address Maker sells over 200 plots at Apollo Address, Nelamangala, in six weeks
news.summary: About 100 villa plots of 1,200-2,400 sq ft remain in the 23-acre phase of a 90-acre township.

news.headline: Design unveiled for Mumbai International Cruise Terminal at Indira Dock
news.summary: The PPP terminal with JM Baxi pairs cruise operations with retail, hospitality and event space to keep the waterfront active off-season.

news.headline: Magicbricks and SPA Delhi publish a sustainable real estate index for ten cities
news.summary: The index scores cities on green supply, sustainable demand, infrastructure, environmental risk and liveability, with Pune joint top on liveability and Mumbai joint top on innovation. In its survey, 64% of respondents said they would pay more for certified green homes.

news.headline: TCI Express plans ₹500 crore five-year logistics investment and opens three sorting centres
news.summary: New sorting centres in Ahmedabad, Lucknow and Kolkata add about 4 lakh sq ft and take the network to 28, under a ₹500 crore infrastructure plan for the next five years.

news.headline: Aamir Khan leases three Santacruz West flats for ₹38 lakh a month
news.summary: The 48-month lease covers about 12,200 sq ft at Seasons Trimurti from January 2027 with 5% annual escalation, per registration documents sourced by CRE Matrix.

news.headline: Prestige Estates takes 50% stake in 1.5 msf Andheri office project for about ₹500 crore
news.summary: Prestige Falcon Realty Ventures bought half of Advent Convention and Hotels International, which will build about 1.5 msf of leasable offices on a 21,978 sq m Andheri plot with an estimated development value of about ₹4,500 crore.

news.headline: Notandas Realty starts handing over units at Notan House, Juhu
news.summary: With partial occupation approval, the developer began handing over its 34-unit commercial building, where office units are valued at about ₹1 lakh per sq ft and showrooms at about ₹1.5 lakh per sq ft.

news.headline: Bombay High Court lets stalled Chembur society redevelopment proceed
news.summary: The court dismissed homebuyers' appeals so Chembur Shivmurti CHS can go ahead with a new developer, saying members displaced for about 15 years should not wait for the arbitration with the former developer.

news.headline: Cityscape property show to debut in India at Jio World Convention Centre in April 2027
news.summary: Informa Markets will hold the first Cityscape India on 16-18 April 2027 in BKC, with more than 40 developers expected to pitch to HNI, NRI and institutional buyers.

news.headline: Collector sets 25 November tender deadline for ₹450 crore of Hinjewadi-Maan-Marunji road works
news.summary: Work is targeted to start by 20 December, and officials were asked to clear ring-road hurdles on alignment, land acquisition and TDR.

news.headline: Two Baner stations on Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Metro Line 3 likely to open in December
news.summary: Baner Gaon and Baner-Pashan Link Road stations await safety clearance; PMRDA aims to open the full 23.3 km corridor by January 2027.

news.headline: NGT orders Padmavati Associates to pay ₹12.46 crore over three Aundh housing projects
news.summary: The Pune bench set compensation at 10% of the declared project cost for projects built without environmental clearance and asked PMC to prepare a restoration plan within two months.

news.headline: Collector targets November tenders and a December-end start for Chakan-Talegaon road works
news.summary: A collector-led committee set a time-bound plan for the industrial belt's roads, along with action on drain encroachments and heavy-vehicle congestion.

news.headline: Infinite Electronics opens a global capability centre in Pune
news.summary: The connectivity-products maker set up the GCC with ANSR for customer, product, supply-chain and AI work; office size and location were not disclosed.

news.headline: Bhumika Realty has leased about 100,000 sq ft of retail at The Icon, Faridabad
news.summary: Bhumika Realty has leased about 100,000 sq ft of retail at The Icon, its mixed-use project on NH-19 in Sector 27A, Faridabad, with Bikanervala and Jetts Fitness among the latest tenants. It aims to lease another 100,000 sq ft by March 2027.

news.headline: Noida Authority approves ₹280 crore to extend Yamuna Pushta Road 10 km to the Yamuna Expressway
news.summary: The four-lane extension will run from Sector 135 via Sector 150 to the Yamuna Expressway and be built by the UP Irrigation Department. A further ₹34 crore is set aside to resurface the existing 11.5 km stretch.

news.headline: GDA proposes transplanting about 80% of trees on the Hapur Chungi flyover route in Ghaziabad
news.summary: Ghaziabad Development Authority wants to move rather than fell most of the 545-plus trees along the planned 1.2 km elevated road from ALT Crossing to Diamond Flyover. The plan awaits Forest Department approval.

news.headline: CAQM revokes GRAP Stage III in Delhi-NCR, but construction curbs remain
news.summary: CAQM withdrew its 6 November Stage III order as Delhi's AQI improved, keeping Stages I and II in force. A separate 30 October order limiting dust-generating construction and demolition across the NCR still applies.

news.headline: Brigade launches first phase of 40-acre Brigade Autograph on Whitefield-Kadugodi Main Road
news.summary: Brigade Enterprises launched Floris, the first residential phase of its roughly 40-acre integrated development in East Bengaluru, whose master plan also includes an Orion Mall, a Hyatt Regency and WTC Bengaluru-Whitefield. Unit counts and investment were not disclosed.

news.headline: Marriott and Adarsh Group sign 397-key St. Regis Bengaluru, converted from Artezia
news.summary: Adarsh Group will fully renovate Artezia Bengaluru and reopen it under a Marriott management agreement as a 397-key St. Regis, with opening scheduled for October 2027.

news.headline: Embassy Developments launches 59 Embassy ONE Residences at Mekhri Circle with about ₹1,400 crore GDV
news.summary: The 30-storey tower already has its occupancy certificate and offers bare-shell homes of about 4,500-15,000 sq ft. Embassy says the launch lifts its FY27 launches to about ₹9,000 crore of GDV.

news.headline: TGRERA fines Sanali IT Parks ₹25 lakh over unregistered project at Manchirevula
news.summary: Telangana RERA penalised the promoter of Sanali The Edge for selling without registration and barred marketing until it registers. It also passed seven refund or possession orders against other developers.

news.headline: HMDA notifies fresh land auction round targeting about ₹600 crore
news.summary: The round includes two Khanamet parcels at a floor price of ₹99 crore an acre and plots in Mokila, Turkayamjal, Shabad and Kistareddypet, with online auctions on 14-21 December.

news.headline: HMDA's Bachupally plot e-auction raises about ₹55.43 crore
news.summary: Forty of the 50 residential plots offered were sold, with a top bid of ₹60,500 per sq yd and a weighted average of ₹49,737 per sq yd.

news.headline: Madras High Court questions Tamil Nadu's move to drop the Parandur airport
news.summary: A PIL says about ₹680 crore has been spent and over 1,700 acres acquired for the project; the state told the court it is dropping it because of water bodies on the site. The bench issued notice to the state, TIDCO, the Civil Aviation Ministry and AAI.

news.headline: TNHB opens Ashok Nagar and Besant Nagar commercial complexes and offers space to startups
news.summary: The two complexes cost ₹308 crore and ₹23.7 crore. TNHB also plans to list 1,240 commercial units and sites on the e-auction portal in December.

news.headline: CMRL shifts Yellow Line start to 7 am to finish Porur-Vadapalani stations
news.summary: From 24 November, Poonamallee Bypass-Porur Junction services will start an hour later to allow work on seven remaining stations and signalling tests.

news.headline: CRTCL seeks consultants for a 27.3 km Cooum river rejuvenation and riverfront plan
news.summary: Chennai Rivers Transformation Company issued a global RFP for a DPR and transaction advisory covering sewage, flood capacity and riverfront development from Paruthipattu Bridge to the sea.

news.headline: AXA Global Business Services leases 2.58 lakh sq ft at Phoenix Asia Tower, Hebbal
news.summary: AXA's India services arm took three floors of Phoenix Asia Tower in Hebbal on a 10-year lease at about ₹92 per sq ft a month, with 4.75% annual escalation, according to documents accessed by Propstack.

news.headline: Taj Yelahanka opens on Bengaluru's airport road as IHCL's 400th hotel
news.summary: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels has opened the 256-key, roughly ₹500 crore Taj Yelahanka on International Airport Road in North Bengaluru, operated by IHCL under a management contract.

news.headline: Karnataka raises minimum free housing site size to 30x40 feet
news.summary: The state cabinet decided on 19 November to enlarge free and concessional housing sites from 20x30 to 30x40 feet for its plan to distribute 15 lakh sites by 2027, with first-phase allotments from January 2027.

news.headline: Supreme Court bars coercive action against buyers of stalled GM Infinite Global Techies Town
news.summary: The court ordered no coercive steps against about 4,500 buyers who have paid most of the price for the incomplete project, whose developer is in insolvency, and directed them to the Karnataka High Court or NCLT Bengaluru.

news.headline: Mukul Agrawal's Param Capital buys a full floor at Lodha Promina, Worli, for ₹163 crore
news.summary: The investor bought two office units of about 20,000 sq ft making up the 46th floor of the under-construction tower, registered on 6 November, according to registration documents.

news.headline: Supreme Universal launches second phase of its Chembur project
news.summary: Tower C adds about 131 three-bedroom flats from ₹4.89 crore, with an estimated ₹700 crore development value; the four-tower project is expected to reach about ₹3,000 crore.

news.headline: VVCMC drafts a 464-hectare township plan around the Virar bullet train station
news.summary: The Vasai-Virar civic body's general body approved a draft local area plan, prepared with JICA support, and opened it for 30 days of objections; residential use takes about 38% of the area.

news.headline: Maharashtra plans GIS-based micro-zoning of ready reckoner rates, starting with Mumbai
news.summary: The revenue department will value individual plots and buildings by property type rather than whole localities, beginning with Mumbai and the wider MMR; current rates apply until it is implemented.

news.headline: Haryana moves building plan approvals to architect upload with seven-day official check
news.summary: An upgraded online system checks architect-submitted drawings against the Haryana Building Code 2017 and issues a provisional certificate, with district town planners to verify within seven working days; a trial runs to 3 January 2027.

news.headline: NCRTC invites bids for air-rights development at Sarai Kale Khan Namo Bharat station
news.summary: The corporation is tendering about 21,063 sq m of buildable area over the station for a mixed-use commercial project that could include hotels, offices, co-working and retail.

news.headline: Delhi LG sets out a four-point plan for integrated Delhi-NCR development to 2047
news.summary: At an ASSOCHAM event, Lt Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu called for regional coordination on transport, housing, technology-led governance and jobs, but named no specific projects or timelines.

news.headline: Buyers of HMDA's Mokila auction plots cannot register them
news.summary: Parts of the Phase 3 and 4 layout were put on the Section 22A prohibited list, blocking registration for buyers of more than 700 auctioned plots; HMDA says it has sent a fix to the state government.

news.headline: Hopcity Brew Co opens a 500-seat rooftop microbrewery at Sarath City Capital Mall
news.summary: The brewery opened at The HUB on the mall's rooftop and is billed as the city's largest rooftop microbrewery.

news.headline: Work picks up on the ₹2,232 crore Paradise-Shamirpet elevated corridor
news.summary: HMDA is relocating memorials at Parade Grounds for the 18.2 km six-lane corridor on Rajiv Rahadari, which is targeted for completion within 24 months.

news.headline: CMRL finishes all U-girders on the Koyambedu-Alandur stretch of Phase II Corridor 5
news.summary: All 606 girders are now in place on the 9.5 km elevated section, the last lifted near Kathipara on Paul Wells Road.

news.headline: West Bengal to add 435 buses to Kolkata's WBTC fleet
news.summary: The plan includes 152 AC electric and 206 CNG buses; no delivery schedule or routes have been announced.

news.headline: PMC clears encroachments from about 2.06 lakh sq ft across six zones
news.summary: The drive covered Handewadi Road, Vadgaon Budruk, Dhayari, Warje, Koregaon Park, the Peths and Tilak Road, with Handewadi Road the largest single clearance.

news.headline: Prestige Estates plans over ₹45,000 crore of launches in two years
news.summary: The developer lined up projects across Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Chennai, Hyderabad and Goa over the next two years.

news.headline: Sebi member says REITs and InvITs will be widened for long-term infrastructure funding
news.summary: Sebi's KVR Murty said the regulator is expanding long-term funding through AIFs, REITs and InvITs, which already have more borrowing flexibility, alongside faster IPO timelines.

news.headline: Core infrastructure output rises 10.9% in October; cement up 15.4%
news.summary: Eight-core output grew at the fastest pace in the new data series, with cement up 15.4% and steel up 7.3% year on year.
